user.title: Olight Ostation
user.description: The station is controlled entirely over your local network. You need its Tuya device ID and local key — see the README for how to read them from the Osite app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the station. Check the IP address and the local key, and close the Osite app — the station accepts only one local connection at a time.
error.invalid_device_id: A Tuya device ID is 22 characters long.
error.invalid_local_key: A Tuya local key is 16 characters long.

abort.already_configured: This station is already set up.
